description: Is one country included? Pass its name in any language or its ISO-2 code (map a city to its country first). Returns included true/false, the continent, the mobile networks (operator names + 5G flag) and the cheapest coverage choice that includes it (its continent alone) with the server price and buy_url, plus the whole world at the same size for comparison.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

country.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "Japon", "jp".

gb.description: The data pool in GB, ONE pool for every included country: 3, 5, 10 (more: 20, 30, 50, 100). Omit = 3 GB. Not sure? Call recommend_config.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country and continent names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

name: check_country
title: Is a country included?
